info.name: StockPilot API
info.description:
API tests for the Inventory Management System (StockPilot).

Run the whole collection in order (Run collection). The requests depend on each other: the login saves the token, and created ids are saved for later requests.

IMPORTANT: run it only against the API test server (pnpm dev:apitest, port 5050). That server uses the separate database stockpilot_api_test, so the real data is never changed.

item.name: 01 Health and Login
item.description: The server is checked first. Then the Administrator and a Staff user log in, and Postman saves their tokens for all later requests.

exec: try { json = pm.response.json(); } catch (error) { /* not JSON */ }
// A new number for every run, so names, SKUs and emails never clash with an earlier run

Expected status: 200.
